definition: Assisted-scoring context; does not measure passing ability.
formula_rule: With >=50 observed minutes, >=3 games and >=100 possessions: assisted rate <=0.4 More self-created; >=0.7 Mostly assisted; otherwise Mixed.
comparison_population: Pointwise calculation on fixed 45-team cohort; no league ranking
missing_value_behavior: Unknown if evidence or fraction is inadequate.
validation_thresholds: Valid assisted fraction 0–1; context exposure thresholds required.
provenance: Independently derived phase1_v1; not an official ESPN rating

definition: Relative component magnitude, not a quality score.
formula_rule: With context exposure and finite components: opposite signs Mixed-sign; abs(off-def) <=0.2*(abs(off)+abs(def)) Balanced; otherwise larger abs component sets leaning. Both zero Balanced.
comparison_population: Pointwise calculation on fixed 45-team cohort; no league ranking
missing_value_behavior: Unknown if component/exposure evidence inadequate.
validation_thresholds: Offensive-leaning and Defensive-leaning refer to magnitude, including negative impacts; no composite score.
provenance: Independently derived phase1_v1; not an official ESPN rating

definition: Review signal for linked source identities.
formula_rule: Agreement if canonical team_id equals fingerprint_team_id and nonempty names match after Unicode accent/punctuation/case normalization; else Review required.
comparison_population: Pointwise calculation on fixed 45-team cohort; no league ranking
missing_value_behavior: Missing identity evidence requires review; IDs never reassigned.
validation_thresholds: Conservative nickname/truncation variants require human review even when player ID joins agree.

definition: Readiness of descriptive evidence, not player quality.

comparison_population: Pointwise calculation on fixed 45-team cohort; no league ranking
missing_value_behavior: Missing key metric or Identity review; never filled to Ready.
